description:
Cast Hada Freeblade by paying {W/P}.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Whenever Hada Freeblade enters the battlefield, it and Ondu Cleric trigger.
Resolve the Hada Freeblade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ondu Cleric trigger, causing you to gain at least two life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Hada Freeblade and the Soldier token, adding {1}{W}.
Whenever Hada Freeblade dies, Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Hada Freeblade from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
